title: An interruption inside the span makes the third occurrence neutral
rationale: The first four plies are mx-rep-001's neutral king shuttle and the last four are mx-chs-001's chase cycle, on mx-chs-001's own position. The three occurrences at plies 0, 4 and 8 are spanned by two Red king moves, and a king's move never chases, so the violation is not sustained across the span and the third occurrence is a neutral claimable draw rather than the loss mx-chs-001 records.
